steps.description: Take the sign containing the planet of interest in the divisional chart of interest
steps.name: graha_sign

steps.description: Find the sign owned by that planet
steps.name: owned_sign

steps.description: Count signs from the sign containing the planet of interest to the stronger sign owned by it, zodiacally
steps.name: count_to_owned

steps.description: Count the same number of signs from the stronger sign owned
steps.detail: 3 signs from Leo ends in Libra
steps.name: advance_from_owned

steps.description: If the sign found is the 1st or 7th from the original sign containing the planet, take the 10th sign from it; otherwise no change
steps.detail: Libra is the 5th from Gemini, neither 1st nor 7th — no change
steps.name: apply_exception

steps.description: The resulting sign contains the arudha pada of the planet of interest
steps.name: graha_arudha
